verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an HR/payroll SaaS like Justworks, but nothing in the pack documents a bulk-action capability, such as bulk employee edits, batch imports or mass updates. Company-, department- and office-level default account mappings for the Xero integration are hierarchical configuration defaults, not user-initiated bulk operations. The probes for llms.txt and an OpenAPI spec both returned 404, so there is also no evidence of a programmatic route for batch actions.
